name: Spotifyd Mini Player
author: Pierre Cagne
description: Bar mini-player for spotifyd over MPRIS: turn this computer into a Spotify Connect speaker you drive from your phone. No Web API, no login, no build step.

barWidget.description: Spotify icon and track title; click for artwork, seek, transport, shuffle, repeat and volume.

schema.label: MPRIS player
schema.description: Case-insensitive substring of the player's D-Bus name. "spotify" matches both spotifyd and the desktop client; "spotifyd" pins it to spotifyd.

schema.label: Maximum title width (px)
schema.description: 0 hides the title and leaves only the icon.
